currentRoundInspection.scope: Useful exterior photographs and existing standard viewer PMTiles/DEM extract. No bespoke surveys or photo redistribution.

pictures.observations: Elevated west/north view: pale west gable and lower flanking chapels, taller green clock cap, shorter brick Silver Bells cone, separate green northern Sigismund tower, steep dark main roofs, red palace roofs beyond. Cathedral is separate from the existing palace model.

West façade: green clock dial and two open copper cap stages, white central gable/rose, narrow roofed stone entry and steps, two low pointed-window chapels, smaller brick octagonal/conical Silver Bells cap. Exact sculpture and tracery omitted.

Southwest view: adjacent dark Vasa dome and gold Sigismund dome/lantern on pale bases; brick transept gable and long pale choir beneath dark roof; green northern bell helmet. Palace is separate to the east.
